fixture_identity: uuid5 dataset sha+scope alias; refuse existing fixture; cleanup only committed owned fixture

metrics.candidate_recall: macro fraction relevant in before-rerank top20; answerable only
metrics.recall: macro fraction relevant in final topK; answerable only
metrics.mrr: first relevant reciprocal rank; answerable only
metrics.ndcg: gain=2^grade-1; discount=log2(rank+1); normalize by ideal graded labels; answerable only
metrics.precision: relevant returned / requested K; answerable only
metrics.no_answer_false_hit: any final hit / all 15 unanswerable queries
metrics.latency: warm search including PG/S3, model tokenization/scoring; nearest-rank P50/P95

acceptance.rerank_no_answer_false_hits_max: not more than Dense final false-hit case count

production_default: lexical regardless of synthetic result; qualified teacher review and independent acceptance still required
